text: The last mark on the map is the riverside garden. I kept it for a day that felt important.

name: mai/chapter3/garden
alt: A winding garden path beside a river
caption: The long way home is my favorite.

then.text: I'm glad we said how we feel. I don't want to hide it behind a map anymore.
We can keep taking our time. I still want to walk beside you.
I feel ready to call this the beginning of something real.

otherwise.text: I had a lovely day. Whatever we call it, I want to see you again.

text: So, what should we call this first date?

options.label: Our first date. And not our last.
options.say: Our first date. And not our last.

then.text: Then it's a date. I'm happy the map brought us here.

options.label: A good beginning. Let's take our time.
options.say: A good beginning. Let's take our time.

then.text: I like that. We can leave the next page open.

options.label: One more walk in the Riverside Garden?
options.say: One more walk in the Riverside Garden?

then.text: Meet me at the sunset path. I'll bring the map.
